title: Cases for an unrolled gate
statement: For any sequential circuit and any natural number $p$, either the gate specified at position $p$ has at most one argument and is not a NOT gate, or it equals a gate from the combinational circuit with its arguments placed at stage $\lfloor p/s\rfloor$, where $s$ is the sequential circuit's size.
